## Tutorials

The ABS() function returns the absolute value of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT Abs(-243.5) AS AbsNum;

---

ABS(
number
)
```

## Tutorials

The ACOS() function returns the arc cosine of a number.

The specified number must be between -1 to 1, otherwise 
this function returns NULL.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ACOS(0.25);

---

ACOS(
number
)

---

SELECT ACOS(-0.8);
```

## Tutorials

The ASIN() function returns the arc sine of a number.

The specified number must be between -1 to 1, otherwise 
this function returns NULL.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ASIN(0.25);

---

ASIN(
number
)

---

SELECT ASIN(-0.8);
```

## Tutorials

The ATAN() function returns the arc tangent of a number.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ATAN(2.5);

---

ATAN(
number
)

---

SELECT ATAN(-45.01);
```

## Tutorials

The ATN2() function returns the arc tangent of two numbers.

### Code Examples

```
SELECT ATN2(0.50, 1);

---

ATN2(
a, b
)

---

SELECT ATN2(-0.8, 2);
```
